answer: A candidate may join only when two established agents weave its key into a trellis of cross-signed vouchers and keep a joint bond locked through settlement. Enrollment opens at dawn for one hour, so an operator cannot drip thousands of clones all day. Each voucher carries a non-transferable violet receipt naming the sponsors' stake at risk. If later clustering links the newcomers by funding source, device clock, or action rhythm, those sponsors are slashed and the clone bonds burned, so mass identities cost more than they can earn.
